column1: # F#: namespaces and modules (package), module-level lets (function when it takes
# arguments or is bound to a lambda, else variable), types (union, record, class,
# delegate, enum are class; explicit interface is interface; an abbreviation such
# as `type Id = int` is type_alias), exceptions (class), members (method when it
# takes arguments, else field), abstract signatures likewise.
# Class-private lets, union cases, record fields and `new` constructors are not listed.

# AndGroup.fsx: each function of a `let rec ... and ...` group is recorded at its own line. Builders2.fsx and Wrapper.fsx: `member inline` with arguments, type, module and namespace headers, an internal constructor with `as self`.
